title: Schema-validated registered component renderer (GenUI)
acceptance: Only registered components with validated props render; arbitrary component, code or action payloads are rejected and logged
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
validation: Regression or fixture for each acceptance item; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Initial plan from the record's Check at featurePlans adoption; estimate, owner may revise. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 3 hours agent; former 2-day estimate at 1.5 agent hours per focused day. Method: 1.5 h/day judged rate (PR #277). Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 2 kept as history. Implemented 2026-11-12 (PR #300): schema-validated registered component renderer (GenUI) via SurfaceRenderer and catalog validator (nerv-status-card, nerv-notice-card); arbitrary component names, action payloads and executable code payloads are strictly rejected and logged with security audit trail; accessible rejection alert passes AXE AA; covered in test/protocol.test.ts, test/surface-dom.test.mjs, and test/angular.browser.mjs. Actual 0.75 h agent (stated).
